completion_decisions: Treat boundary-grid parameterization as the paper target contribution; direct and grid representations are intrinsic controls.
Collapse the three one-factor experiment axes to seven unique problem cases while retaining every paper comparison.
Replace unavailable proprietary SNOPT with a declared deterministic feasibility-first parallel evolution strategy; never claim author-SNOPT replay.
Resolve paper/source turbine constant conflicts in favor of the paper and register both values in the contract.
Retain the released direction-zero wind-resource behavior and disclose the missing Akima dependency.
Use pure-C++ candidate-batch parallelism for optimization and wind-state parallelism for final evaluation.
missing_information: SNOPT binary and license are not included in the public archive.
The legacy akima Python package is not included.
Author random states and original result files are absent.
The repository has no root LICENSE file; setupRevision.py declares Apache License 2.0.
